title: DAP与DDP：谁承担进口清关
summary_zh: ICC公开解释区分DAP与DDP的进口清关责任；采用DDP前应确认卖方在目的国是否能够履行相关义务，并核对合同约定地点和版本。
summary_en: ICC explains that DAP and DDP allocate import-clearance responsibilities differently. Destination rules may prevent a seller from undertaking the obligations expected under DDP.
tradex_workflow: Read the contract before assigning tax and clearance costs; ask who can act as importer and which costs were actually agreed.
cash_effect: Only put taxes and duties into the exporter’s cash plan when its contractual responsibility is established.
title_en: DAP versus DDP: who handles import clearance?

evidence_refs.locator: Public explanation of DAP and DDP import clearance

ICC explains that DAP and DDP allocate import-clearance responsibilities differently. Destination rules may prevent a seller from undertaking the obligations expected under DDP.
